q004: Overall, there was an increase in the value of exports to Japan, China and Russia, while the figures for Mexico and Saudi Arabia declined overall. In addition, Japan consistently had by far the highest figure, whereas Saudi Arabia had the lowest.
q010: Overall, there was an increase in cinema attendance in all four age groups, with the largest rise in percentage points being seen among 15–24-year-olds. In addition, this group consistently had the highest figures, while those aged 35 and over had the lowest.
q011: Overall, there was an increase in spending on books in all four countries, with the greatest overall rise being seen in Austria. In addition, Germany consistently had the highest figures, while Austria overtook Italy by the end of the period.
q013: Overall, there was a decline in the proportion of households without a car, while the shares owning one or more cars increased overall. In addition, one-car households became the largest group in the final two years, replacing households without a car.
q014: Overall, there was an increase in car production in Argentina and Thailand over the period, while a decline was seen in Australia. In addition, Thailand consistently had by far the highest figures, despite a fall after its peak in 2006.
q022: Overall, there was a decline in the consumption of beef, lamb and fish, while an increase was seen in chicken consumption. In addition, chicken became the most consumed item during the period, whereas fish consistently had the lowest figures.
q023: Overall, there was an increase in the proportion of female members of parliament in all five countries, with the largest rise being seen in the UK. In addition, Italy overtook Germany to record the highest figure in the final year, while the UK ended at approximately the same level as Belgium.
q026: Overall, there was a decline in female unemployment in three countries, while a rise was seen in Scotland. In addition, the highest rate shifted from England to Scotland, with the largest decline being recorded in Northern Ireland.
q028: Overall, there was an increase in coffee exports in all three countries over the period. In addition, Brazil became the largest exporter, while Colombia showed the sharpest fluctuations and had the lowest figure in the final year.
q032: Overall, there was an increase in the renewable-energy share in all six countries, with the greatest rise being seen in Germany. In addition, Germany became the leading country, while the USA consistently had the lowest figures.
q035: Overall, there was an increase in both types of telephone subscription, with much stronger growth being seen in mobile use. In addition, mobile subscriptions overtook fixed lines around 2001 and finished well ahead.
q041: Overall, there was an increase in paper and packaging production, while sawn wood and wood pulp ended below their initial levels. In addition, paper and packaging consistently had the highest output, whereas wood pulp showed a partial recovery towards the end.
q044: Overall, there was an increase in the shares of women with no children, one child or two children, while the shares with three or more children declined. In addition, having two children consistently remained the largest category.
q050: Overall, there was a clear increase in higher-education participation in Countries A and D, while the figures for B and C changed relatively little. In addition, Country D consistently had the highest proportion and recorded the largest overall rise.
q059: Overall, there was a decline in the male smoking rate, while the female rate rose initially before falling. In addition, men consistently had higher rates, although the gap between the two groups narrowed considerably.
q061: Overall, there was an increase in the shares of food and beverages and video games, while electronics and appliances and home furnishings declined. In addition, food and beverages replaced electronics and appliances as the largest online retail sector.
q076: Overall, there was an increase in the renewable-energy shares of Iceland and Sweden, while Australia and Turkey ended below their initial levels. In addition, Iceland consistently had the highest figures and recorded the largest rise.
q083: Overall, there was a decline in the proportion of students travelling by car, while a rise was seen in all four other modes of transport. In addition, buses replaced cars as the most common choice in 2009, although their share remained below half.
q084: Overall, there was an increase in film production in Countries B, C and E, while Country A declined at the end and Country D fluctuated. In addition, Country A consistently had the highest figures, followed by Country B.
q085: Overall, there was a decline in the proportion of government spending on roads and transport in Italy, Portugal and the UK, while a rise was seen in the USA. In addition, Portugal generally had the highest figures, although Italy overtook it in 2000, while the UK consistently recorded the lowest proportions.
q090: Overall, there was an increase in car production in Argentina and Thailand over the period, while a decline was seen in Australia. In addition, Thailand consistently had the highest figures, despite a fall after its peak in 2005.
